status: Concept proposals only; no map changes or approved selection.

variants.detail: VARIANT A: intimate natural canopy tunnel, strongest sense of walking into a hidden woodland. Foreground entrance still catches soft daylight; two bends vanish behind overlapping trunks before opening into a blue-green shaded clearing. Layered broadleaf crowns join overhead at edges like a soft umbrella, very few low moss banks, NO enclosing cliffs. Place a petite crooked-roof timber book-and-craft cottage nestled against a huge old tree's roots at the UPPER LEFT edge, half screened by trunks; one golden window is the focal reward beyond the clearing, short side porch. Three small warm knitted lanterns lead along the bends, leaf litter and gentle ferns. Plush 'scary' faces are sparse hidden surprises, simple paper-cardboard tooth frame around ONE tree hollow, no Halloween pumpkins. Quiet, cozy, sheltered, clear contrast between dark leafy edge and usable clearing. Keep architecture modest and believable.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape environment concept illustration for the existing game 小白鹅大冒险, region named 很吓人的森林！. Create ONE wide landscape image, one coherent playable environment, no panels, no UI, no HUD or captions. Input image 1 is STYLE AND SCALE reference only (existing game test arena); replace its crude giant cylindrical stump and sunny lighting entirely. Input image 2 is the approved little spider identity: cream/cocoa round fluffy body, huge plum eyes, eight short rounded legs, adorable. Match the game's soft hand-painted pixel-cluster storybook environments, moss rocks, detailed grass, plum-edged cute pixel characters; visible pixel texture, not photorealistic, not smooth 3D render, not a glossy cinematic painting. Elevated fixed three-quarter game camera around 35 degrees looking down enough to understand walking routes; broad readable ground, no extreme aerial map view. Composition must show an entrance at lower right/foreground, a gently winding approach path with TWO bends leading into a deeper forest clearing, then one small warm-lit craft-and-book cottage at a SIDE/REAR edge of that clearing. Main playable clearing about 28x24m, approach about 25-35m as a design impression; do not claim exact geography. Keep an open central fighting area with a substantial living trunk/root island dividing a shorter right route and wider left bypass, and two roomy pockets for standing to fight. Trees and tall canopy enclose perimeter and shade the floor; no realistic cave horror, no pitch black, ground/enemies must stay readable. Local cool blue-green/lavender shade contrasted with a few small warm amber bedside-style lamps under knitted covers. Handmade 'trying to be scary but actually cute' props at perimeter only: one or two round cloth puppets with crooked angry eyebrows and sewn paper-like teeth, visible stitches and strings reveal make-believe, not real monsters. Decorative silk overhead or on props; a maximum of one cream loose ground web patch should not obscure main routes. A tiny white-haired chibi girl and exactly three tiny black goose companions near approach give scale, three or four tiny approved B spiders busy arranging props, NO giant spider, NO swarming realistic legs, NO spider-sister character design yet. Cottage has visible warm window, a little side door, small books/craft materials near porch, wood and textiles, quiet lived-in detail; no enormous building. No readable text, labels or watermarks. Preserve welcoming childlike charm with a little playful suspense.

variants.brief: B：小蜘蛛布置的吓人游乐林
variants.detail: VARIANT B: clearly a handmade pretend haunted playground arranged by little spiders. Wider, slightly more open purple-blue moonlike canopy shade despite daylight glimpsed at entrance; woodland still natural, no festival crowd, no amusement-park machinery. A crooked twig entrance arch hung with two funny soft fabric faces, a tiny puppet display tucked into SIDE bushes, hand-tied cream silk bunting, a few dropped buttons/wooden spools reveal the craft. Small spiders fuss over one floppy cloth puppet with overly angry stitched eyebrows, cute and incompetent. Warm bedside lamps in fabric shades form alternating little pools along a two-bend path. Put a tiny asymmetrical shingle cottage at the REAR RIGHT edge, a warm porch/worktable with a couple of unfinished cloth toys, round window and small book shelf visible through window, no detailed interior cutaway. Main ground remains open and readable; props concentrated in distinct peripheral vignettes, not an obstacle maze. Most playful and mischievous option.

variants.brief: C：苔岩围合与半藏式手工小屋
variants.detail: VARIANT C: strongest spatial enclosure, a shallow woodland hollow backed on LEFT and REAR by softly rounded mossy rocky shoulders about 2-3m above clearing floor, layered tall tree trunks and crowns above. Do not surround all sides with mountains or create a cave dungeon. The approach runs gently DOWN around a moss shoulder through two bends, opens to roomy level grass clearing, no narrow combat staircase. Place a beautifully detailed little timber book/craft house HALF NESTLED beside a rear moss bank at UPPER LEFT/CENTER, side door opening onto a tiny warm porch and front pocket, not inside a black cave; slanted patchwork roof, asymmetrical warm windows, cream knitted curtains, discreet root supports. Cool deep teal/lavender woodland shade with soft dappled daylight opening above central ground; low warm amber lamps and a few luminescent-looking but subtle tiny fungi on margins, no bright neon. A gentle silk hammock with a grumpy cloth doll at the side. Most secluded and fairytale-like option, intimate warm house against cool taller surround.
